measurementDefects: Initial clipping heuristic incorrectly uses zero-height BODY rectangle instead of propagated viewport overflow; original findings preserved.
Initial contrast misses filled border images, overlapping media and ancestor group effects above opaque child backgrounds. Original zero-failure result is not a contrast pass.
Initial prose selection counts receipt field labels/data but misses header disclaimers; refined counts include disclaimers and retain all raw words.
next: Shorten workshop/disclaimer/receipt copy without losing costs, burn semantics or payer information.
Use solid text backplates where textured/image backgrounds cannot establish AA contrast; inspect the actual product.
Rebuild production, rerun both journeys, and extend to keyboard/focus and secondary panels. ART-owned battle labels remain separate.
